_comment: Example config for the AKS EE upgrade worker.ps1. Copy to config.json in your ConfigDir and replace placeholder values. The launcher writes this file from its parameters in the scalekit path.
_runIdNote: Opaque per-deploy identifier recorded in the completion tag (siteops.aksee.upgrade.runId) so a tag can be correlated with a specific deploy. The Bicep defaults it to the deploy time.
_allowKubernetesMinorUpgradeNote: When false (default), the worker applies patch updates only. When true, the worker performs sequential minor-version hops. AcceptUpgrade is re-pinned false after successful completion. A failed run preserves the staged update cache.
_targetKubernetesVersionNote: Optional. When allowKubernetesMinorUpgrade is true, the worker stops hopping once the deployed Kubernetes minor version matches this value. Accepts formats like '1.33' or 'v1.33.5+k3s1'. Empty string means upgrade to the latest available.
_authNote: The worker authenticates with the Arc machine's system-assigned managed identity (az login --identity) for the post-upgrade verification and the completion tag. Grant it Contributor on the resource group, or Kubernetes Cluster - Azure Arc Onboarding plus Tag Contributor for least privilege. No service principal is used.
_scheduledTaskNameNote: Optional. Defaults to SiteOpsAksEeUpgrade when omitted.
